description: Structured extract of CSAB Special Rounds business rules from the official CSAB brochure currently published on the CSAB Special page. This should be refreshed when the 2026 brochure is published.
note: The live CSAB Special page currently exposes the 2025 official brochure PDF. The rules below are extracted from that official brochure text only.

eligibility.summary: CSAB Special rounds are open to candidates eligible for the NIT+ system through JEE Main, subject to nationality and brochure conditions.
facts: Fresh registration is mandatory for CSAB Special rounds.
Candidates who are not Indian nationals and are not OCI/PIO card holders are not eligible for seat allocation through CSAB Special to NITs, IIEST, IIITs, SPAs, and other GFTIs.
Final admission confirmation is subject to production of valid original eligibility documents and physical verification at the admitting institute.
Reservation rules follow Government of India norms.
The brochure enumerates multiple eligible candidate types, including candidates who skipped JoSAA, had no seat, exited, withdrew, or held NIT+ seats through JoSAA.

special_round_registration.summary: All eligible candidates must register afresh on the CSAB portal; JoSAA registration does not carry forward.
facts: Earlier JoSAA registration is not valid for CSAB Special rounds.
Candidates whose documents were not verified in JoSAA may update state of eligibility, nationality, gender, and category from beneficiary to non-beneficiary category during CSAB registration.
Candidates whose category changed to GEN during JoSAA may request category restoration if they later acquire valid certificates.
If a candidate does not register within the scheduled window, the candidate will not be considered in any CSAB Special round.

special_round_enrolment_fee.summary: After registration, candidates must pay the Special Round Enrolment Fee, which combines admission-fee and processing-fee components.
facts: SREF includes Institute Admission Fee-I and a non-refundable Special Round Processing Fee of Rs. 5,000.
Type-6, 7, 8, and 9 candidates get previously paid JoSAA SAF balance adjusted as part of SREF and pay only the difference amount where applicable.
At SREF payment time, candidates must provide bank-account details and upload a cancelled cheque or passbook front page for refund processing.
IAF-II must be paid when a seat is allotted for the first time in CSAB Special rounds if the candidate is proceeding with Freeze, Float, or Slide.
Non-payment of IAF-II is treated as rejection of the allocated seat and removes the candidate from subsequent rounds.

choice_filling_and_locking.summary: Candidates must fill fresh choices for CSAB; JoSAA choices become void for CSAB allotment purposes.
facts: Previously filled JoSAA choices are null and void for CSAB Special allotment.
Candidates must save at least one choice to be considered for seat allotment.
If choices are not locked, the last saved choices are auto-locked at deadline; if no choice is saved, the candidate is not considered for allotment.
Locked choices can be unlocked before deadline through portal request validated by OTP sent to registered mobile and email.
After deadline, candidates cannot reorder, add, or delete choices.
Candidates who secured JoSAA seats and still participate in CSAB must also fill fresh choices; their last secured NIT+ seat is automatically treated as the last choice.

seat_allotment_and_online_reporting.summary: Seat allotment is published online only and candidates must complete online reporting to retain a newly allotted seat.
facts: Seat allotment is carried out according to JEE Main 2025 CRL for vacant seats.
Candidates must check allotment status themselves; no separate intimation is guaranteed.
Online reporting includes exercising willingness, uploading documents where applicable, paying IAF-II, and responding to verification queries.
If all documents and eligibility checks are satisfied, the seat is provisionally confirmed; final acceptance still depends on physical reporting and institute-side verification.
Failure to complete online reporting within the round timeline is treated as rejection and bars the candidate from later rounds.

document_verification.summary: Verification is online for applicable candidates and is required before provisional seat confirmation.
facts: Document verification applies to candidates whose documents were not already verified in the NIT+ system during JoSAA rounds.
Candidates must resolve queries through the CSAB portal within the published schedule.
Failure to resolve verification queries in time leads to seat cancellation and loss of eligibility for subsequent rounds.
After successful verification, seat confirmation remains provisional until physical reporting and final institute checks.
PwD verification may be online through UDID upload or physical at a verification centre, depending on the candidate's disability-document status.

willingness_options.summary: Candidates use freeze, float, slide, surrender, withdraw, or exit to control continuation in later rounds.

definitions.freeze: Accept the offered seat and stop participating in further rounds while retaining the same seat.
definitions.float: Accept the offered seat and remain eligible for higher-preference programs in any institute in later rounds.
definitions.slide: Accept the offered seat and remain eligible for a higher-preference program within the same institute in later rounds.
definitions.surrender: Reject the allotted seat but stay in the process for the next round; allotment will then be considered only from choices above the surrendered seat.
definitions.withdraw: Reject the allotted or accepted seat and leave the seat-allocation process entirely.
definitions.exit: Available only to candidates with no allotted seat; leaves the process entirely before the last round.

rules: Surrender is not available in the last round.
In the last round, all allotments are presumed accepted with freeze.
Once freeze is chosen, it cannot later be changed to float, slide, or surrender.
Candidates who do not save any willingness despite holding secured JoSAA seats and participating in CSAB are automatically moved with default float, or freeze if allotted first choice.
If a higher-preference seat is allotted after float or slide, the previous seat is automatically replaced and cannot be claimed later.

withdrawal_exit_and_refund.summary: Withdraw and exit remove the candidate from the process; refunds are partial and subject to deduction of processing charges.
facts: Withdraw is available only up to before the last round and requires portal request plus OTP confirmation.
A withdrawn seat is cancelled and the candidate is excluded from later CSAB Special rounds.
Exit is only for candidates who have not been allotted a seat and is available only before the last round.
Candidates who exercise exit or withdraw are not considered for subsequent rounds and forfeit admission through that CSAB Special cycle.
The brochure states that withdrawing candidates receive refund of part of SREF after deducting applicable processing charges.
After physical reporting failure at the allotted institute, the brochure states that no refund will be admissible.

physical_reporting.summary: After all special rounds conclude, confirmed candidates must physically report to the allotted institute and complete admission formalities.
facts: Physical reporting occurs after Special Rounds I, II, and III are completed.
Candidates must follow instructions published by the allotted institute and pay the balance institute fee, if applicable.
Failure to complete institute-level reporting and balance-fee payment may lead to cancellation.
